exposure: Loss of double-line sign on MRI
Disorganized abnormal placenta vascularity on MRI
outcome: Invasive placental accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders (placenta increta and percreta)
cohort: 183 patients with 'uncertain ultrasound diagnosis' of invasive PAS disorders (118 in a primary cohort and 65 in a validation cohort)
finding: An MRI-based nomogram incorporating history of cesarean deliveries, loss of double-line sign, abnormal uterine bulging, and disorganized abnormal placenta vascularity showed good accuracy for predicting invasive PAS disorders in patients with uncertain ultrasound diagnosis.
